shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"' && cat /workspace/node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/ | grep -i cache
(npx next start -p 3100 &>/tmp/next.log &) && sleep 4 && curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'Notifications are [a-z]*'

ACTION_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]*"' | sed 's/name="\$ACTION_ID_//;s/"//') && echo "action: $ACTION_ID" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3100/ -H "Next-Action: $ACTION_ID" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --data "\$ACTION_ID_$ACTION_ID=" -o /dev/null -w "POST status: %{http_code}\n" && curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'Notifications are [a-z]*'

curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3100/ -F "\$ACTION_ID_004405b956771cf6b15ddab32437703a49f33248ec=" -o /dev/null -w "no-JS form POST status: %{http_code}\n" && curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o 'Notifications are [a-z]*' && tail -5 /tmp/next.log
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 2 http://localhost:3100/ || echo "server stopped"
